title: Slovakian Hash with Roasted Peanut Crust
description: A hearty Slovakian-inspired hash with a crunchy peanut crust, perfect for a comforting dinner. This dish combines smoky flavors with a satisfying crunch.
instructions: In a bowl, mix together hash, 1 tablespoon olive oil, and a pinch of salt.
Transfer the hash mixture to a 9x9-inch baking dish.
In a separate bowl, mix together peanut butter, peanut shattering, and 1 tablespoon honey.
Spread the peanut mixture evenly over the top of the hash.
Bake for 20-25 minutes or until the peanut crust is golden brown and the hash is heated through.
Remove from oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
